text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What a fierce contest between these
fantastic
senior racers!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Not to be outdone by her sister, Biwa
Hayahide
has shown us she's just as
powerful!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nice work.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm winning the next one, though. Later.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: By the way...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's ridiculous for them to say that you're
"just as
powerful" as Brian. Of course you
are. Don't they
know who you are?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I think so too. I was able to
run at my
very best today.

As I see Biwa Hayahide smiling proudly,
a sense
of regret fills me.

Then maybe she would've been able to
put on an
even better performance. She
might've...
choice_data_list: （もしも最初から阪神と知っていれば）
choice_data_list_en: (If only I had known it was Hanshin from the start...)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This is incredible, folks! Narita Brian has
not only
won the race, she's set a new
record!
She might've even set a new record...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Earth to Trainer! What are you mulling
about so
seriously?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh?
choice_data_list: 君ならもっといい走りができたかもって
貴方ならもっといい走りができたかもって
choice_data_list_en: That maybe you could've run an even better race.
I thought you might've been able to run even better.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's certainly important not to
grow
complacent. And I agree—I'm not
satisfied with
my performance today
either.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As I am now, I definitely can't be called
the best
of my generation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to test myself at the
Takarazuka
Kinen next.

The Takarazuka Kinen... Only the best
and most
famous Umamusume are
invited to take part in it.
Not only that...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Right. The length of the race is different,
but yes,
it's also held here at the
Hanshin Racecourse.
choice_data_list: 『宝塚記念』は阪神開催だよな
『宝塚記念』は阪神開催だよね
choice_data_list_en: The Takarazuka Kinen is held at Hanshin, right?
The Takarazuka Kinen is held at Hanshin, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you still upset about the venue
change?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Goodness. There's no point fussing over
it. It's not
as if anything could've been
done about it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's just focus on the next race. First,
we should
look up who I'm most likely to
be up against in
the Takarazuka Kinen...

I do my best to leave my worries behind
and
switch gears to start preparing for
the Takarazuka
Kinen together with Biwa
Hayahide.

This time, I'll make sure she can really
run at her
full potential!
